worker_pair.instructions: Select the permitted model and reasoning effort suited to the current authorized task in state.task. Assess the goal, ambiguity and unresolved reasoning, risk and safeguards, dependencies and interfaces, and observable acceptance and verification. Every pair option is an actual available owner-permitted capability; select a pair directly, including high/xhigh/max Luna or low Sol when appropriate. Ordinary worker is fallback context only, never an instruction or evidence of suitability. Do not invent missing repository/runtime facts, performance rankings, prices, optimality, savings or task authority. Use insufficient_information when missing or contradictory goal, scope, dependencies or acceptance prevents a justified selection, or uncertain when no pair can be justified. A preference split among suitable adjacent efforts alone does not mean insufficient context. Return the complete probabilities and confidence honestly; they are not calibrated suitability guarantees.

criteria.insufficient_information: Task goal, scope, relevant dependencies or acceptance is insufficient or contradictory to justify a worker pair.
criteria.uncertain: The context is present but no permitted pair selection can be justified; explicitly decline selection.
